安装RES4LYF！！！

高度优化的 ComfyUI 工作流程，旨在使用 Wan2.2-S2V-14B 模型生成具有明显运动的长动态视频，只需 4 个采样步骤即可完成。

该工作流程是“Motion Forge”系列的下一步发展，突破了效率和长度的界限。它利用复杂的链接机制按顺序扩展视频剪辑，允许从单个参考图像和音频文件创建更长的视频，同时保持高运动质量和连贯性。

使用型号： 万2.2-S2V-14B-Q8_0.gguf

📖 描述

厌倦了短的、低动态的剪辑吗？此工作流程就是您的解决方案。它专为想要创建比标准输出长的富有表现力的音乐视频风格动画的用户而设计。通过利用强大的“Video S2V Extend x5”组节点，工作流程采用初始视频潜伏并在五个阶段中逐步构建。

这里的关键创新是极低的步数（4 步）结合高 CFG (6) 和专门的采样 (统一电脑, β57），优先考虑快速、创造性和高能量的运动生成。它非常适合音乐动画、创建动态场景或任何需要流畅、夸张的运动而不是逼真的静止的应用。

✨ 特点和亮点

  • 🔥 超快速生成：仅4步每个采样通道使得生成过程对于所达到的视频长度来说非常快。

  • 💥 高动态输出：特意配置了高 CFG 比例和特定的采样器/调度器，以最大限度地提高最终视频中的运动和活力。

  • 🎬 长格式视频：核心“Video S2V Extend x5”节点链接了五个连续的代，将基本剪辑转变为更长的序列。

  • 🎵 声音转视频 (S2V)：通过 Wav2Vec 编码器完全集成音频分析，将视觉运动同步到输入音轨（DEXTER_JUSTICE.wav在示例中）。

  • 🧹内置内存管理：包括easy cleanGpu使用, VRAM清理, 和内存清理节点以确保长时间生成过程中的稳定性。

  • 🔧 智能预处理：自动调整大小并准备参考图像（ComfyUI_02140_.png）以获得最佳兼容性。

  • 🎯 生活质量修复：包含一个“愚蠢的黑客”（如工作流程中所述），通过复制然后在解码后删除它来修复 VAE “过度烘焙”的第一帧。

🛠️技术细节

工作流程：ComfyUI（包括 JSON）
主要型号： 万2.2-S2V-14B-Q8_0.gguf
夹子型号： 牛-umt5xxl-q4_0.gguf
VAE： Wan2_1_VAE_fp32.safetensors
音频编码器： wav2vec2_large_english_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors
洛拉： lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank128_bf16.safetensors（强度：1.38）

🚀 使用说明

  1. 加载工作流程：将提供的 JSON 文件导入 ComfyUI。

  2. 检查模型路径：确保所需模型文件的路径（万2.2-S2V-14B-Q8_0.gguf等）中装载机GGUF, 剪辑加载器GGUF, 和瓦格古夫节点指向系统上的正确位置。

  3. 输入您的媒体：

    • 参考图片：更换加载图像节点的路径与您自己的起始图像。

    • 音频文件：更换加载音频节点的路径与您自己的音频文件（例如歌曲、对话或音景）。

  4. 调整提示：修改里面的文字CLIP 文本编码节点（正和负）来描述所需的场景并排除不需要的元素。

  5. 队列提示：运行工作流程！结果将是一个与音频合并的视频文件，保存到您的 ComfyUI 输出目录中。

💡 工作流程分解（“神奇”酱）

为了清晰起见，工作流程按逻辑分组：

  1. 第 1 步 - 加载模型：加载核心 Wan 模型、VAE，并应用专门的 LoRA 来增强性能。

  2. 第 2 步 - 上传音频和参考图像：将您的源媒体送入管道。

  3. 第 3 步 - 批量设置：设置全局参数，如批量大小、块长度和采样步骤。

  4. 第 4 步 - 提示：您在其中定义视觉样式和内容。

  5. 基本采样：最初的万声图像转视频和KS采样器节点，从您的图像和音频中创建第一个潜在的短视频。

  6. 视频S2V扩展X5（核心）：该自定义组节点是工作流的引擎。它获取初始视频并通过五个独立的扩展周期运行它，每个扩展周期都有不同的种子，有效地“梦想”视频及时前进，同时保持原始图像和音频的条件。

  7. 修复过度烘烤的第一帧：A post-processing chain that decodes the final latent video, corrects a visual artifact on the first frame, and extracts the final video frames.

  8. Final Combine:的VHS_VideoCombinenode takes all the generated frames and the original audio file to render the final MP4 video.

📝 Example Prompt from the Workflow

Positive Prompt:
"Professional male driver in car interior, NYC night cityscape through windows, neon lights reflection on face, subtle head turn toward passenger camera, contemplative expression, cinematic bokeh from street lights, dashboard illumination, urban atmosphere, smooth camera movement, noir aesthetic, moody lighting with blue and orange tones, 4K quality"

Negative Prompt:
"色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走"
(Translation: Avoids over-saturation, over-exposure, static images, blurry details, text, artwork, bad quality, ugly, deformed, extra fingers, bad hands/face,畸形, cluttered background, etc.)

⚙️ Recommended Settings

  • For even longer videos:You can increase the "Chunk Length" or add more extension blocks by replicating theVideo S2V Extend组。

  • For different motion styles:Experiment with theCFGscale. Lower values (3-5) may produce subtler motion, while higher values (7-10) can create even more dramatic effects.

  • If coherence breaks:Try using a slightly higher step count (6-8) in thePrimitiveIntnode titled "Steps".

⚠️ Limitations & Notes

  • Coherence Decay:与任何视频扩展技术一样，视频时间越长，与原始参考图像的一致性可能会降低。

  • 高 VRAM 使用率：生成长视频可能会占用大量 VRAM。内存清理节点对于稳定性至关重要。

  • 艺术性的，不真实的：4 步方法针对富有表现力的运动进行了优化，而不是为了实现完美、稳定、逼真的帧。拥抱输出的抽象和动态本质！

INSTALLRES4LYF !!!!

A highly optimized ComfyUI workflow designed to generate long, dynamic videos with pronounced motion using the Wan2.2-S2V-14B model, all in just 4 sampling steps.

This workflow is the next evolution in the "Motion Forge" series, pushing the boundaries of efficiency and length. It leverages a sophisticated chaining mechanism to extend video clips sequentially, allowing for the creation of significantly longer videos from a single reference image and audio file while maintaining high motion quality and coherence.

Model Used: Wan2.2-S2V-14B-Q8_0.gguf

📖 Description

Tired of short, low-motion clips? This workflow is your solution. It's engineered for users who want to create expressive, music-video-style animations that are longer than the standard output. By utilizing a powerful "Video S2V Extend x5" group node, the workflow takes an initial video latent and progressively builds upon it over five stages.

The key innovation here is theextremely low step count (4 steps)combined with a high CFG (6) and specialized sampling (uni_pc, beta57), which prioritizes fast, creative, and high-energy motion generation. It's perfect for animating to music, creating dynamic scenes, or any application where fluid, exaggerated movement is desired over photorealistic stillness.

✨ Features & Highlights

  • 🔥 Ultra-Fast Generation:Only4 stepsper sampling pass makes the generation process remarkably quick for the video length achieved.

  • 💥 High-Motion Output:Deliberately configured with a high CFG scale and specific sampler/scheduler to maximize movement and dynamism in the final video.

  • 🎬 Long-Format Video:The core "Video S2V Extend x5" node chains five sequential generations, turning a base clip into a much longer sequence.

  • 🎵 Sound-to-Video (S2V):Fully integrates audio analysis via a Wav2Vec encoder, synchronizing the visual motion to the input audio track (DEXTER_JUSTICE.wavin the example).

  • 🧹 Built-in Memory Management:Includeseasy cleanGpuUsed, VRAMCleanup, andRAMCleanupnodes to ensure stability during long generation processes.

  • 🔧 Smart Pre-processing:Automatically resizes and prepares the reference image (ComfyUI_02140_.png) for optimal compatibility.

  • 🎯 Quality-of-Life Fixes:Incorporates a "stupid hack" (as noted in the workflow) to fix the first frame being "overbaked" by the VAE by duplicating and then removing it post-decoding.

🛠️ Technical Details

Workflow:ComfyUI (JSON included)
Primary Model: Wan2.2-S2V-14B-Q8_0.gguf
CLIP Model: cow-umt5xxl-q4_0.gguf
VAE: Wan2_1_VAE_fp32.safetensors
Audio Encoder: wav2vec2_large_english_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors
LoRA: lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank128_bf16.safetensors(Strength: 1.38)

🚀 Usage Instructions

  1. Load the Workflow:Import the provided JSON file into ComfyUI.

  2. Check Model Paths:Ensure the paths to the required model files (Wan2.2-S2V-14B-Q8_0.gguf, etc.) in theLoaderGGUF, ClipLoaderGGUF, andVaeGGUFnodes point to the correct locations on your system.

  3. Input Your Media:

    • Reference Image:Replace theLoadImagenode's path with your own starting image.

    • Audio File:Replace theLoadAudionode's path with your own audio file (e.g., a song, dialogue, or soundscape).

  4. Adjust Prompts:Modify the text in theCLIP Text Encodenodes (Positive and Negative) to describe your desired scene and exclude unwanted elements.

  5. Queue Prompt:Run the workflow! The result will be a video file combined with your audio, saved to your ComfyUI output directory.

💡 Workflow Breakdown (The "Magic" Sauce)

The workflow is logically grouped for clarity:

  1. Step 1 - Load Models:Loads the core Wan models, VAE, and applies a specialized LoRA for enhanced performance.

  2. Step 2 - Upload Audio & Ref Image:Feeds your source media into the pipeline.

  3. Step 3 - Batch Settings:Sets the global parameters like batch size, chunk length, and sampling steps.

  4. Step 4 - Prompt:Where you define the visual style and content.

  5. Basic Sampling:The initialWanSoundImageToVideoandKSamplernode that creates the first short video latent from your image and audio.

  6. Video S2V Extend X5 (The Core):This custom group node is the engine of the workflow. It takes the initial video and runs it through five separate extension cycles, each with a different seed, effectively "dreaming" the video forward in time while staying conditioned on the original image and audio.

  7. Fix Overbaked First Frame:A post-processing chain that decodes the final latent video, corrects a visual artifact on the first frame, and extracts the final video frames.

  8. Final Combine:TheVHS_VideoCombinenode takes all the generated frames and the original audio file to render the final MP4 video.

📝 Example Prompt from the Workflow

Positive Prompt:
"Professional male driver in car interior, NYC night cityscape through windows, neon lights reflection on face, subtle head turn toward passenger camera, contemplative expression, cinematic bokeh from street lights, dashboard illumination, urban atmosphere, smooth camera movement, noir aesthetic, moody lighting with blue and orange tones, 4K quality"

Negative Prompt:

(Translation: Avoids over-saturation, over-exposure, static images, blurry details, text, artwork, bad quality, ugly, deformed, extra fingers, bad hands/face,畸形, cluttered background, etc.)

⚙️ Recommended Settings

  • For even longer videos:You can increase the "Chunk Length" or add more extension blocks by replicating theVideo S2V Extendgroup.

  • For different motion styles:Experiment with theCFGscale. Lower values (3-5) may produce subtler motion, while higher values (7-10) can create even more dramatic effects.

  • If coherence breaks:Try using a slightly higher step count (6-8) in thePrimitiveIntnode titled "Steps".

⚠️ Limitations & Notes

  • Coherence Decay:As with any video extension technique, coherence with the original reference image may decrease the longer the video gets.

  • High VRAM Usage:Generating long videos can be VRAM-intensive. The memory cleanup nodes are crucial for stability.

  • Artistic, Not Photorealistic:The 4-step approach is optimized for expressive motion, not for achieving perfect, stable, photorealistic frames. Embrace the abstract and dynamic nature of the output!
